classification.difficultyReason: Infer angle relationships from equal-side marks, parallel rectangular-strip edges and perpendicular folded edges.

inlines.text: Juna is exploring angles by folding rectangular strips of paper.
Work out the size of each angle marked

spec.description: Unshaded horizontal strip extending right, with its folded portion descending right. Preserve the dashed sloping and horizontal segments, matching single ticks, upper 50-degree sector and lower x sector.
spec.mathematics: The ticked sides form an isosceles triangle with a 50-degree base angle. Its remaining angle is 80 degrees. The two long folded edges are parallel, transferring that angle to x. Drawing coordinates preserve the source's illustrative proportions rather than measuring its stated angles.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 50-degree angle, matching ticks and unknown x are visible.

answer.short: $x=80^{\circ}$. Equal base angles give $180^{\circ}-50^{\circ}-50^{\circ}=80^{\circ}$; alternate angles on parallel strip edges give $x=80^{\circ}$.
answer.worked:
The marked equal sides form an isosceles triangle, so its two base angles are $50^{\circ}$. Let its third angle be $c$.

$$\begin{align*}c+50^{\circ}+50^{\circ}&=180^{\circ}\\c+100^{\circ}&=180^{\circ}\\c&=80^{\circ}\end{align*}$$

The long edges of the folded rectangular strip are parallel, so $x=c$ by alternate angles.

$$x=80^{\circ}$$

spec.description: Unshaded horizontal strip extending left, with the folded right portion projecting upward right. Preserve the dashed right edge, the 40-degree sector at the lower-right base vertex and the obtuse x sector above the top edge.
spec.mathematics: The folded rectangular-strip corner is a right angle. A folded long edge makes 40 degrees with the horizontal, so the perpendicular short edge makes 50 degrees with the horizontal. Its exterior supplementary angle is 130 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 40-degree angle and unknown x are visible; no supplementary or right-angle working is added.

answer.short: $x=130^{\circ}$. The folded corner is $90^{\circ}$, giving $50^{\circ}$ beside $x$; hence $x=180^{\circ}-50^{\circ}=130^{\circ}$.
answer.worked:
The top and bottom edges of the horizontal strip are parallel. The folded corner is $90^{\circ}$, so the acute angle beside $x$ is $90^{\circ}-40^{\circ}=50^{\circ}$.

Angles on a straight line sum to $180^{\circ}$.

$$\begin{align*}x+50^{\circ}&=180^{\circ}\\x&=130^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
